messages:
emily: Pushed a docs PR to update the model card and catalog entry for Solace-6B quant variants. Covers supported quant profiles, limits table, micro-bench results, and a short migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1910

arpit: Thanks — can you be explicit about which profiles are supported on CPU vs GPU? customers keep getting confused by `quant` label.

emily: Yep. I added a Compatibility row: `profiles: q4_0 (gpu), q4_1 (gpu), q4_cpu_fallback (cpu, reduced throughput)` and a short note: "Use `solace-6b:quant-q4_cpu_fallback` for CPU-only hosts; expect lower throughput and an initial JIT/cold-start latency."

sasha: Can you drop the exact bench command and tokenizer version so eng-ml can reproduce? also include memory footprint.

emily: Added the harness snippet and trimmed output we observed:```bash
bench_harness run --model solace-6b --profile q4_1 --seq 2048 --bs 8 --tk v3.4.1
# results (median of 3 runs)
throughput: 94.7 tokens/s per GPU
p95 latency: 225 ms
gpu mem peak: 11.1 GB
```

arpit: Numbers look sane. One small wording nit: change "cpu fallback" to "CPU fallback" and mention the observed cold-start penalty (we saw ~400ms on first call).

emily: Fixed wording and added: "observed cold-start: ~400ms for q4_cpu_fallback on first invocation (kernel JIT + cache warmup)."

sasha: For docs consumers, can we add an SDK snippet showing the explicit variant tag? otherwise folks try `solace-6b:quant` and hit ambiguity.

emily: Added this Python example to the Examples section:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="solace-6b:quant-q4_1", prompt="Summarize the paper...", max_tokens=120)
print(resp.text)
```

arpit: Also update the limits table: `max_sequence_length: 8192 (recommended for fp16/quant up to 8k)`, `recommended_batch_size: 8 for q4 variants`. And add a short note about quality regression checks when migrating from fp16 to q4.

emily: Done. I added a tiny migration checklist at the bottom of the card: 1) copy prompt sets, 2) run quality regression on holdout set (accept threshold e.g. ROUGE/embedding cosine), 3) validate latency and p95 on staging, 4) enable gradual rollout with canary at 10% traffic.

sasha: Can you also add a link to the bench harness repo and the exact tokenizer checksum? helps later audits.

emily: Linked bench harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench-harness and added tokenizer sha256: `a3f5...9b1c`.

arpit: LGTM from eng-ml. One last micro-ask: mention whether quant variants support streaming responses or any feature limitations.

emily: Good catch. Added: "Feature notes: streaming supported for q4_1 and q4_0; q4_cpu_fallback supports streaming but may increase p95 due to CPU scheduling."

docs-bot: PR #1910 merged to main by emily 389 Changes: model card update, examples, migration checklist, bench link.

emily: Thanks team! I'll follow up with a short blurb for the release notes and add the `small-llm` search tag for the catalog index.

sasha: Nice. Closing out.
